data.short_meaning: Descender, or the one who is lowered
data.long_meaning: The name Jarrad originated from Jared in Hebrew, which means 'descender' or 'the one who is lowered'. In the Bible, Jared is listed as the father of Enoch, the seventh patriarch in the line of Adam. This name is a powerful reminder of humility and submission to God's will. The name Jarrad carries the meaning “Descender, or the one who is lowered” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jarrad usually hope their child will grow to embody descender, or the one who is lowered and live with faith, good character and purpose.
